job.name: ig9_host_a
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary-looking man — not a celebrity, not a model.
job.meaning: мужчина ~35 на подкасте: тёмные короткие волосы, аккуратная щетина, оливковая рубашка-овершот, кожаное коньячное кресло, фон — терракотовая стена с полками и тёплой лампой; смотрит вбок на собеседника
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a man about 35 years old, a guest on a video podcast: short dark-brown hair, neat short stubble, an olive-green cotton overshirt over a white t-shirt, sitting in a cognac leather armchair. Background: terracotta plaster wall with softly blurred wooden shelves, a few books and a warm brass table lamp, creamy bokeh. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, he sits on the left-center of the frame, seen from the waist up with his lap and hands visible, head turned about 30 degrees to the right as if answering an interviewer sitting off-camera to the right, eyes looking off-camera to the right, face clearly visible and sharp, large in frame (top of head ~16% below upper edge). A black broadcast podcast microphone on a boom arm enters from the left edge and stops in front of his chest, BELOW his chin, never covering the mouth or face. Expression: calm, sincere, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted showing a hint of teeth, NO smile. Look: a candid still frame from a real high-end video podcast, shot on a cinema camera with a 50mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, soft warm key light, natural unretouched skin with pores, real hair. No text, no letters, no logos, no captions, no watermark, no headphones.

attempts.issue: Face must be frontal and looking directly into the camera, microphone partially obstructs the subject
Subject is looking off-camera; needs frontal view facing camera
Person is not looking at the camera and not front-facing
